dataset_title: Dataset for building fault detection and diagnostics algorithm creation and performance testing
source_type: Physical FLEXLAB experiments on test cell X3A air handler, two control modes; manually imposed faults; not occupied production operation
ground_truth: Inventory Tables 3-3 and 3-4 date-to-component mapping, binary CSV fault column cross-checked offline
exclusions: RTU and MZVAV experimental files outside bounded scope
transformation: Three complete 60-minute windows at 10,12,14 local recording hours per run. Preserve degrees F and fractional commands. Summarize mean/min/max/end-start. No statistical preprocessing fit for LLM. Source date, filename, fault indicator and taxonomy label withheld.
split: First chronological run of every class within each mode for development; remaining whole days evaluation; all windows of a day kept together
independence: 26 experimental day blocks on one equipment/test facility, not 26 independent buildings. Three windows within each block are correlated. Conditional day-block inference only.

sql.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 data; MIT repository code
sql.limitation: Public SQLite records omit sol_sql and test_cases; official route requires email. No contact made.
sql.fallback: BIRD-SQL public development references and database downloads exist at https://bird-bench.github.io/; separate database audit and valid execution study cannot fit remaining original deadline while completing primary measured study. No SQL inference or empirical claim.
